text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Once again, happy birthday, Bamboo. Did 
you like your birthday gift?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir! A birthday cake eating contest 
was a surprise at first, sure, but—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
A nail-biting showdown with all the thrill 
of a real race! Man, that was totally 
irresistible!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I lost, but I'm super-duper 
satisfied!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness... It is your birthday, 
after all. I wanted you to have a good 
time.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Could it be... you remembered how I 
told you competing with Oguri-senpai was 
super fun...?!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was having fun too, so... hearing 
you say that made me very happy.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the celebration! It 
was delicious and got me super fired up... 
The best birthday ever!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... So here's an idea: how about we go 
for a run together right now to work off 
our meal?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!! I'm not gonna lose this time—!!
